purpose: Read-only bounded fresh on-disk OMF/MXF Original Bin inspection. No implementation changes.
readerMethod: Current Release MediaMuster core, QFile read-only/unbuffered through counting QIODevice, 32 MiB total source-read ceiling. MXF and OMF readers interpret metadata and seek past essence; no whole essence hashing. All actual source-read ranges re-read independently to verify bytes unchanged, alongside size/mtime checks.

diagnostics: 2 dictionary IDs have ambiguous definitions; all definitions are retained without choosing a name.

limits: Path inventory covers listed roots, not every inaccessible/system folder on startup volume.
MXF header inspection is a stratified sample across each known existing managed media folder, not every inventoried MXF.
No interpreted bin field and no known bin-name bytes in inspected ranges is not a proof against unknown private encodings, compression, or other producers.
The standard Package.Name or a tag containing the letters bin does not establish Original Bin.
OMF positive samples are genuine Avid supporting media copies in this repository on startup volume; no .omf discovered on EDIT in inventoried tree.

publishedSources.title: Avid OMF Interchange Specification 2.1 (1997), Avid-authored mirrored PDF
publishedSources.finding: Optional named attributes and extension classes are defined; reviewed base Mob properties do not prescribe an Original Bin field. Exact Avid private OMF1 keys are verified independently from the files.

publishedSources.title: SMPTE ST377-1:2019
publishedSources.finding: The core Generic Package table has Package Name, not Original Bin. Header extensions are permitted; unknown metadata need not be interpreted. This does not prohibit an application-specific bin association.

publishedSources.title: Avid Interplay Access User Guide 2022.3
publishedSources.finding: Original Bin describes the original capture bin. Its listing as a system metadata property does not establish a universal media-header encoding.

conclusions: At least some genuine Avid OMF media files embed an original-bin name through _ORG_BIN to MCBR to OMFI:MCBR:MC:binName. The positive inspected OMF names Media Slides.

No identifiable Original Bin value was found in the 21 sampled MXF headers. Generic tagged-value names and known-name byte searches are recorded independently of the absent OriginalBin projector mapping.
The EDIT 1001.WAVA01.D8875D202DA97BA.mxf has an exact identity match to same-folder MDB metadata naming D001_SOUND; that name is absent in sampled MXF metadata ranges under the checked encodings.
These are bounded samples, not a full-volume header parse or proof that every MXF producer omits bin information. A format capability, an observed stored value and reader support are distinct facts.
No application source, media, database or bin contents were changed by this research. Previous Original Bin scheduling implementation remains separate.
